title: Research: verify the complete PR2979 native/helper boundary
body:
## Summary

Verify the finite source/native boundary of both complete original PR2979 streams and all 408 arbitrary dirty-helper outputs, in both orientations.

```diff
 native review coverage
- PR3038/3238 endpoint and private-free cones
+ both complete streams and every original dirty-helper output
```

The new package is `research/rank7-complete-native-boundary`. Every word, allocation and paid cost stays unchanged. No new supplier, kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3238 covered 2,648/3,167 native classes and 3,717/4,537 native event occurrences per provider. Its helper output root was helper249.
  **After:** all 3,481 classes and 5,125 native occurrences per orientation pass, adding 833/314 classes and 1,408/588 event occurrences. Across both providers, 13,924 phase-exact identity checks on 512 address columns, 1,632 helper observations and 364 actual private frees pass. A separate retained backward source-covector algorithm checks every helper too.
- A literal inverse-transpose ADD sign fault at event 21,886 leaves helper287 equal to x287-2*x286 while all older private-free/helper249 observations pass. The complete helper check rejects it. Newly covered native global-phase faults also reject.
- Fresh registered Python 3.12.15 / NumPy 2.3.5 replay, eight normal/optimized behavior groups, Ruff, original-source lineage, and all 33 committed-byte/source-history comparisons pass. The actual committed Git-free export passes both fresh full providers in normal Python and both test modes; all 34 payload/transport files, modes and inodes remain unchanged.

Canonical base is `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`; original construction is `be191346391661f4d35fc0d1508d0a6029572576`. Exact pins, full receipts, proof, reproduction and remaining obligations are committed. [Canonical scoped claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-19009367).

The source decoder, native selector, Gaussian kernel, forward arithmetic and backward covectors are credited reused independent checking tools. This extends their coverage. Individual identities already covered by the group-A/B audits and the parallel [group-C audit #3436](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3436) retain their credit. The increments above are relative to PR3238, not claims of new individual identities across all those audits.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

Only an isolated research package is added. Physical rational scalar/COPY/CLEAR and zero-allocation contracts remain premises. Normalized helper restoration retains its paid native residual factor. Physical backing/owner fit, precision/tape, intended source/target application, supplier/outer and universal obligations remain separate. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.
